## 7-Stage SDLC Quality Checklist
- [ ] **Gate 1 (Spec & Architecture)**: Contract/schema changes validated.
- [ ] **Gate 2 (UI/UX & Human Factors)**: $\ge 48\text{px}$ touch targets verified; Hebrew (RTL) and English (LTR) mirroring tested.
- [ ] **Gate 3 (Implementation)**: Clean code standards adhered to.
- [ ] **Gate 4 (Code Review & Scalability)**: Complexity analyzed ($O(1)$/$O(N)$); no unneeded re-renders or memory leaks.
- [ ] **Gate 5 (Security & OWASP)**: Input sanitization, Firestore security rules, and authorization verified.
- [ ] **Gate 6 (Performance & Chaos)**: CWV targets met; offline/PWA resilience verified.
- [ ] **Gate 7 (QA Verification)**: Static analysis (`npm run lint`), tests (`npm run test`), and build (`npm run build`) pass with 0 errors.
